target.statement: Median ROC AUC of BISECT-based self-supervised one-class classification on the Wilt dataset (0.975)
target.dataset: Wilt (from Campos et al. 2016 outlier evaluation benchmark)

compute.basis: The target is a single table cell from a small tabular dataset (4819x5); the paper's code is available but may require R/Python environment setup and the exact data splits are not fully specified, so reproducing the exact median AUC over 7 random splits may take a couple of hours of command time.

blockers: Code repository may not include exact data splits or preprocessing scripts
Requires R and Python with reticulate, caret, and other packages
Exact random seeds for the 7 splits are not reported
title: Efficient Generation of Hidden Outliers for Improved Outlier Detection
